question: Conditional on reported enemy contact exposure, does current independently recorded TFES unit quality add heldout information about next-month friendly casualty risk beyond personnel quantity, manning, prior contact/casualty history, unit type, province, and seasonality?
theory_link: Historical analogue of the frozen synthetic result that capability memory/quality affects losses and survival beyond headcount. TFES quality is broader than Pineland veterancy V_G and is not called V_G.

sources.state_quality_and_personnel: direct NARA TFES unit records, parsed by studies/vietnam_1955_1975/scripts/parse_tfes_direct_v1.py
sources.future_performance: direct NARA VNUS monthly RF/PF records, parsed by studies/vietnam_1955_1975/scripts/parse_vnus_direct_v1.py
sources.identity_rule: TFES district_id + unit_type + unit_series == VNUS district_id + unit_type + unit_id_3
sources.identity_selection_guard: The identity rule was selected only by same-month identifier overlap (98.86% VNUS match), before performance effects were computed.

inspected: TFES/VNUS record layouts and example records
TFES source anomaly rate present-for-duty > assigned
not_inspected: quality coefficient sign in the frozen model

quality_operator.name: TFES core adequacy fraction

excluded_questions.F: category 5 means not measurable under current mission
excluded_questions.J: shortage type is categorical, not ordinal
excluded_questions.M-T: not required for the minimal documented core operator

quality_operator.formula: fraction of the 10 included questions rated 1 or 2
quality_operator.primary_completeness_rule: all 10 included questions must have documented values 1-4
quality_operator.scale_claim: ordinal threshold only; no equal interval spacing among ratings is assumed
quality_operator.direction: higher = more TFES dimensions rated good/satisfactory

primary_risk_set.identity: exact frozen crosswalk key; ambiguous duplicate TFES key-months excluded
primary_risk_set.vnus_future: valid next-calendar-month VNUS row exists for same unit

primary_outcome.name: next-month friendly casualty incidence conditional on contact
primary_outcome.definition: 1 if VNUS next-month friendly KIA + WIA + MIA > 0, else 0
primary_outcome.interpretation: survival/loss-risk observable conditional on reported contact exposure, not unit destruction

baseline_model.estimator: unregularized logistic regression; no hyperparameter tuning
numeric_features: log1p(next-month VNUS contact operations) as realized exposure adjustment

secondary_predeclared.quality_quartile_casualty_risk: report heldout raw risk by adequacy quartile; not a promotion gate
secondary_predeclared.casualty_burden_per_contact: compare log1p friendly casualties / log1p contact exposure descriptively
secondary_predeclared.reported_exchange: enemy KIA+captured versus friendly KIA+WIA+MIA is descriptive only because body-count error is source-sensitive
secondary_predeclared.training_recency: report whether any documented basic/refresher/motivational/revolutionary-development training occurred within 12 months; secondary because training-date coverage is incomplete
secondary_predeclared.source_anomaly_sensitivity: rerun descriptively including present>assigned rows, but primary result is never replaced by sensitivity output

guards: TFES evaluation quality is not Pineland veterancy V_G.
VNUS casualties and body counts are reporting-system observations with nonidentified error.
Conditioning on realized next-month contact exposure defines a survival-under-contact estimand; it is not a total causal effect of quality on battlefield casualties.
No result from this contract may retune the synthetic theory.
